nodes.text: explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): Use one Explore sub-agent to own one complete read-only Fireship channel catalog session. Obtain the channel/video-list identifier, continue the returned list identifier with the platform's navigation cursor/page operation until source exhaustion, and retrieve details only as needed for complete title, integer view count, duration, description, and tags. Rank the whole observed catalog by view count descending with a stable Video_ID tie-break and return exactly the verified top five with rank, duration minutes, one evidence-supported primary topic, key technologies, and catalog page/row/duplicate controls. Do not stop after the first page or write artifacts.

explore 1 (web-domain-researcher 1): Use one Explore sub-agent to own the complete read-only travel branch. Resolve Beijing South and Qufu East station codes through the station lookup; query 2026-03-12 outbound and 2026-03-15 return tickets with the resolved codes; select a task-suitable after-work evening outbound and afternoon return by actual times, availability, and first-class (`一等座`) evidence; then retrieve intermediate stops for exactly those two selected train/date pairs. Return one compact two-leg table preserving actual Chinese station/seat labels, train numbers, timestamps, duration, first-class price, and stop-list/ticket coverage. Do not invent a price or translate returned labels.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole writer of `Tech_Conference_Plan.xlsx`. Create the exact three sheets from the frozen payload with exact headers/order, five videos, two travel legs, at least six schedule rows, and literal values only. Read all sheets back and return path plus row/value checks.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole owner of the exact-title `Tech Conference Preparation - Qufu March 2026` page. Search exact title, create or complete one nonduplicate page with both actual train journeys and all five learning topics/relevance notes, retrieve it, and return ID plus coverage checks.
